shortDescription: update segment information for VxRail cluster layer3.

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: The version of API to call

options.name: ip_version
options.description: The type of ip address

options.name: management_gateway
options.description: The IPv4 gateway address of the management traffic for the segment

options.name: management_gateway_ipv6
options.description: The IPv6 gateway address of the management traffic for the segment

options.name: management_netmask
options.description: The subnet mask of the management traffic for the segment

options.name: management_prefix_length_ipv6
options.description: The prefix length of the management traffic for the segment

options.name: management_topology
options.description: The topology type for management traffic for the VxRail cluster

options.name: management_vlan
options.description: The VLAN ID of the management traffic for the segment

options.name: proxy_ip
options.description: The IP address of the node which provides proxy service

options.name: segment_label
options.description: The name of the segment

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for update lay3 segment infomation, the default value is 60 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: version
options.description: Version number of VXM

options.description: The subnet mask for the vMotion traffic of the segment

options.name: vmotion_prefix_length_ipv6
options.description: The prefix length for the vMotion traffic of the segment

options.name: vmotion_vlan
options.description: The VLAN ID for the vMotion traffic of the segment
